note: What a server sends to light up part of the screen, as a tutorial does. Only HudHighlightToggled turns it off. The header carries zero.

fields.name: element
fields.note: What to light up on the main controls, 0 to 8; a client ignores a larger value. 4, 5 and 6 each name a part of a second panel. Which part each value names is not recorded.

fields.name: number
fields.note: Which slot, for a spell or a summoner spell; it has no effect for 4, 5 or 6.

1.note: A shop element blinks once, where the shop window is open. Element 0 is the buy button, 1 the sell button, 2 the shop item number names, 3 the item second names within the category number names, and 4 the recommended item number names.
